goal_summary: Check that every way a product gets into the cart (product page, catalog card, wishlist move) follows the requirements: quantity classes, stock limits, price, persistence for guest and user; requirement is the oracle, not the code.

shopping cart.reason: main subject: stock checks, quantity limits, badge, guest merge

checkout and payment.reason: scope is only the add-to-cart function

orders, cancellation and refunds.reason: scope is only the add-to-cart function

sign-in and user accounts.reason: guest vs signed-in cart, merge at sign-in, session expiry (no expectation authored)

roles and permissions.reason: guest and USER may add; admin used only to create test books

API contract and errors.reason: POST /api/cart answers 400 VALIDATION_ERROR, OUT_OF_STOCK, INSUFFICIENT_STOCK, 404 BOOK_NOT_FOUND
